// FUNC 1800784f4 __fpe_flt_rounds
int __cdecl _fpe_flt_rounds()
{
  unsigned int control; // eax
  int common_round_control; // eax

  control = _acrt_fenv_get_control();

      v19 &= ~0x40u;
      set_fpsr(v19);

    v26 = v19 & 0x6000;

    {

          break;

// FUNC 18007e450 _FindPESection
__int64 __fastcall FindPESection(__int64 a1, unsigned __int64 a2)
{
  unsigned int v2; // r9d
  __int64 v3; // r8
  __int64 result; // rax
  unsigned __int64 v6; // rdx

  v2 = 0;
  v3 = a1 + *(int *)(a1 + 60);
  result = v3 + *(unsigned __int16 *)(v3 + 20) + 24LL;
  if ( *(_WORD *)(v3 + 6) == 0 )
    return 0;
  while ( 1 )
  {
    v6 = *(unsigned int *)(result + 12);
    if ( a2 >= v6 && a2 < (unsigned int)(v6 + *(_DWORD *)(result + 8)) )
      break;
    ++v2;
    result += 40;
    if ( v2 >= *(unsigned __int16 *)(v3 + 6) )
      return 0;
  }
  return result;
}
// ENDFUNC
// FUNC 18007e4a0 _IsNonwritableInCurrentImage
__int64 __fastcall IsNonwritableInCurrentImage(__int64 a1)
{
  __int64 result; // rax

  result = ValidateImageBase(0x180000000uLL);
  if ( (_DWORD)result != 0 )
  {
    result = FindPESection(0x180000000LL, a1 - 0x180000000LL);
    if ( result != 0 )
      return *(int *)(result + 36) >= 0;
  }
  return result;
}
// ENDFUNC
// FUNC 18007e4f0 _ValidateImageBase
_BOOL8 __fastcall ValidateImageBase(__int64 a1)
{
  __int64 v1; // rdx

  return *(_WORD *)a1 == 23117 && *(_DWORD *)(v1 = a1 + *(int *)(a1 + 60)) == 17744 && *(_WORD *)(v1 + 24) == 523;
}
